$doc: Contact-us page animation spec — Webflow IX2 → GSAP conversion. Companion doc: contact-us-animations.md. Raw decoded IX2 source: webflow-ix2-contact-us.raw.json (22 events / distilled from the same site-wide registry as home/menu).

meta.engine: Webflow IX2, shared registry with home/menu
meta.sharedRecipes: riseBlurFade (a-10/a-33/a-48), fade (a-46), slideInRight, ctaExplosionSettle (a-112) — all defined in home-animations.json / menu-animations.json, not redefined here.
meta.differencesFromMenuCta: This page's CTA has NO ambient orbit loop (no a-113/PAGE_START event found for this page in the registry) — the original genuinely only animates this closing section on some pages, not all. The GSAP conversion honors that: CtaCollage is called without withOrbit here, with it on /menu.

animations.name: Navbar recolor on scroll

webflow.raw: Same PAGE_SCROLL continuous pattern as home/menu.

animations.implementation: Shared across all routes via site-header-client.tsx.

animations.name: Heading / quick-contact / image / form rise-in

webflow.raw: riseBlurFade on each block — heading, quick-contact links, the image+locations card, and the form panel each get their own trigger. Note: unlike home/menu, several of this page's triggers fire immediately since the hero sits at the very top of the page (SCROLL_INTO_VIEW at offset 0% is satisfied on load).

animations.implementation: Reveal island wraps the whole hero; [data-reveal] on the heading block, the quick-contact column, the image+locations card, and the form panel — one shared stagger timeline.

animations.name: Form submit / loading / success feedback

webflow.raw: Webflow's native form success/error swap (w-form-done / w-form-fail).

gsap.note: Not an animation in the original beyond the instant DOM swap; reimplemented as React state (idle/submitting/success/error) with a disabled+ellipsis submit button during the mock request.

animations.implementation: contact-form-client.tsx useState status machine, mock contactAction (700ms) in src/lib/mock-actions.ts.

animations.name: Label / heading / description / button / features rise-in

webflow.raw: Fade wrap on the features grid and image column (see home-animations.json a-46).

animations.implementation: Reveal island — same pattern as home's brew-section and menu's now-shared feature-block layout, freshly authored for this page's copy (not a shared component; see contact-us-animations.md for why).

animations.name: Two product shots slide in from the right

webflow.raw: Identical to home's brew-section — content left, images slide in from the right (not slideInLeft like menu's guide).

animations.name: Image collage explodes in, settles, then exits (desktop scrub)

webflow.raw: Same recipe as menu's CTA — see menu-animations.json newRecipes.ctaExplosionSettle.

animations.implementation: Shared CtaCollage component (extracted from the menu page during this migration, now used by both routes) — withOrbit omitted here to match this page's source, which has no a-113/PAGE_START event.

webflow.raw: Same small/tiny-breakpoint simplification as menu's CTA.
